name: Affix | 6pk CBD Patches | Rest
description: RestFIX™ is our all-natural relaxation and mood boosting Hemp patch. It was specially formulated to help de-stress and assist with mind racing anxiety. Perfect after a long day or week. Bring some much needed zen to your day with RestFIX. Patch on and chill out with an Affix Hemp patch. Ideal for: Stressful Days Relaxation Mood Boost Affix Hemp patches use transdermal technology to deliver through the skin. Our Hemp patch formula is all-natural, safe, non-habit-forming and contains no trace of THC or cannabis. Affix Patches provide consistent delivery over a 24 hour period and you can remove whenever you like. By adding Magnolia Essential Oil to our all-natural RestFIX Hemp formula, this patch supports with relaxation.
